faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Field Worker position?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting your application for the Field Worker position at AIIMS Delhi is 17 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for the Field Worker post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Field Worker post is a 10+2 pass from a recognized board. Further details can be found in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be selected for the Field Worker role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Field Worker position at AIIMS Delhi involves two main stages: shortlisting of CVs and an interview. Candidates will be evaluated based on these steps.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the AIIMS Delhi Field Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Field Worker recruitment at AIIMS Delhi. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for the Field Worker position at AIIMS Delhi is to be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their resume and required documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Field Worker post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Field Worker post at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Field Worker position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Field Worker position will be as per DHR regulations. Specific details regarding the salary structure can be obtained from the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I attach with my application?
faq.answer: You should attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with your application.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from any state apply for this position?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for AIIMS Delhi, located in Delhi. While candidates from all states are generally encouraged to apply for government jobs, it's advisable to check the official notification for any specific domicile requirements.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this Field Worker position?
faq.answer: The Field Worker position at AIIMS Delhi is a contractual job. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms specified in the appointment letter.
